idea-plugin.name: Kotlin Coroutine Visualizer
idea-plugin.description:
Visualize Kotlin coroutine execution directly in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Real-time coroutine hierarchy tree view
  • Timeline visualization with suspension points
  • Event log with filtering and search
  • Integration with VizScope instrumentation library
  • DebugProbes fallback for zero-configuration use

Getting Started

  1. Add coroutine-viz-core dependency to your project
  2. Replace CoroutineScope with VizScope
  3. Open the Coroutine Visualizer tool window (View → Tool Windows)
  4. Run your application — events appear in real-time

action.description: Run the current configuration with coroutine visualization enabled
